svg.title: Editable ensemble-centered ECD/VCD graphical abstract

svg.text: Quantum-chemical ECD/VCD: from conformers to spectra
Sampling + reliable populations determine the averaged spectrum
Solvent environment: PCM / SMD • explicit solvation • QM/MM
Illustrative molecular geometries and spectra • uncertainty, validation and transferability remain essential
